actions.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups in QEMU from /app/isos/win311.img in snapshot mode, expose VNC on :1/5901, provide nginx web access on port 80, and leave the VM running at the Windows 3.11 desktop with programmatic keyboard input enabled.
required_artifacts: QEMU launch configuration or command line
nginx configuration for port 80 web access
receipt-backed runtime evidence that QEMU is running
receipt-backed evidence that VNC is listening on port 5901
receipt-backed evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop
receipt-backed evidence that programmatic keyboard input is configured
required_behaviors: QEMU uses snapshot mode so the base image remains immutable
VNC server listens on TCP port 5901
nginx serves a web interface on port 80
QEMU remains running in the background after startup
QEMU accepts keyboard input programmatically beyond only VNC user interaction
known_invalid_patterns: Compilation or syntax checks without launching the VM
Non-empty output without confirming the requested VM/VNC/nginx behavior
Prompt echo or configuration text without receipt-backed execution evidence
verification_plan: Inspect the environment for available tools and paths
Create or locate the QEMU launch script/config and nginx config
Start QEMU in snapshot mode with VNC :1 and keyboard-control-capable interfaces
Start nginx on port 80 for remote access
Verify listening ports and VM state using runtime checks
Confirm the VM reaches the Windows 3.11 desktop via VNC or equivalent receipt-backed evidence
finalization_evidence_required: A receipt showing the exact QEMU command or launch configuration used
A receipt showing QEMU running in the background
A receipt showing port 5901 is listening for VNC
A receipt showing nginx is listening on port 80
A receipt showing the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop
A receipt showing keyboard input can be sent programmatically to the VM
